name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
⏱️ Accurate Video Durations: Probes real video lengths for Google Drive items, displaying timestamps (e.g. 0:05) instead of placeholder HD badges.
📁 Hierarchical Subfolder Downloads: Recreates exact multi-level folder structures on disk matching Google Drive hierarchy.
📦 Subfolder Preservation in ZIP: Preserves nested folder directories inside .ZIP archives for clean one-click extraction.
🎵 True MP3 Output: Fixed audio formatting so user-selected MP3 downloads output real .mp3 files without forced .m4a extension.
⚡ Parallel Probing & CEP Sync: Fast concurrent duration probing and folder-aware downloads across Adobe Premiere and After Effects.
